sr: Procedural Detective pitch sequence about generalizability beyond the demo. The same prompt-to-world and deterministic-validation architecture could apply to training scenarios, educational simulations, escape room experiences, interactive storytelling, emergency response drills, and interview or roleplay simulations. One architecture, many worlds.
